SELECT
  (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01') AS ds_units,
  (SELECT sum(qty) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_units,
  (SELECT sum(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01') AS ds_revenue,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS bills_with_atta;

SELECT date_trunc('day',bill_ts)::date AS d,
       count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT d.sku, d.date, d.units_sold, b.book_on_hand_close,
       (SELECT string_agg(s.status, ',') FROM store.shelf_audits s WHERE s.sku=d.sku AND s.audit_ts::date=d.date) AS audit
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
WHERE d.date >= '2026-06-01' AND d.date < '2026-07-01' AND d.units_sold = 0
ORDER BY d.sku, d.date;
SELECT sku, date, units_sold FROM store.daily_sales WHERE units_sold = 0 AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY sku, date;

SELECT p.pick_ts, p.order_id, p.shipment_id, p.sku, p.slot, p.cases_ordered, p.cases_confirmed,
       s.dispatched_ts, s.arrived_ts, s.slot_start, s.slot_end
FROM warehouse.pick_confirmations p
LEFT JOIN warehouse.shipments s ON s.shipment_id = p.shipment_id
WHERE p.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY p.pick_ts;

SELECT s.audit_ts::date AS d, s.sku, s.status,
       (SELECT ds.units_sold FROM store.daily_sales ds WHERE ds.sku=s.sku AND ds.date=s.audit_ts::date) AS units_sold_that_day,
       (SELECT ib.book_on_hand_close FROM store.inventory_book ib WHERE ib.sku=s.sku AND ib.date=s.audit_ts::date) AS book_close
FROM store.shelf_audits s
WHERE s.status='empty'
ORDER BY s.audit_ts;

SELECT pl.bill_id, pl.bill_ts, pl.sku_scanned, pl.qty, pl.unit_price, pl.line_amount
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.bill_id IN ('B260625-060004','B260624-090007')
ORDER BY pl.bill_id, pl.line;

SELECT pl.bill_ts::date AS d,
       count(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) AS bills,
       count(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-1KG') AS bills_1kg,
       count(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-10KG') AS bills_10kg,
       sum(pl.qty) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-1KG') AS units_1kg,
       sum(pl.qty) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-10KG') AS units_10kg
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT gr.received_ts, gr.grn_id, gr.shipment_id, gr.asn_sku, gr.asn_units, gr.sku_booked, gr.units_booked, gr.receipt_method
FROM store.goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.asn_sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' OR gr.sku_booked='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY gr.received_ts;
